title: Restricted Parallel Root-Uptake Canonical Admission Architecture Audit

invariants.note: Admits an additional runtime capability around the same kernel; no separate SWAP version or kernel.
No file, format, parser, unit or path concern enters the kernel/runtime science seam.
Parameters, committed state, forcing, numerical config and results remain explicitly separated.
No new persistent per-column state is introduced.
Heavy solver/backend/transaction scratch remains worker-owned.
No per-column heavy solver ownership; existing canonical scheduler/worker-pool model is preserved.
Shared checkpoint-trial-commit path is reused and negative cases are nonmutating.
No change to committed physical authority or warm-start semantics.
Generic [t0,t1] execution retained; no calendar boundary assumption.
No coupling-window restriction added.
Existing transaction/coupling-ready runtime architecture is preserved; root-active restart remains outside admitted scope.
SWAP-MODFLOW head/flux interface contract unchanged.
Independent replay retains hard <=1e-12 cm per-column balance and complete aggregate mass accounting.
Interface sensitivities unchanged.
No additional coupling full-run burden introduced.
Parallel MultiSWAP root-active execution is the direct admitted use case with 2/4 workers and irregular batches.
No MODFLOW-cell/tile 1:1 assumption added.
Deep-vadose remains external/optional.
No component-transition storage semantics changed.
Common soil-water solver contract remains unchanged; candidate is runtime composition only.
Existing qualified Richards/root-sink physics are reused, not duplicated.
No consumer is coupled to HeadCalc internal arrays.
Root extraction is explicit physical profile state; worker count stays numerical/runtime policy.
Rejected/problem columns remain isolated; no tolerance/fallback policy is silently changed.
Serialized reference execution remains available and was replayed as oracle.
Deterministic result/diagnostic publication, worker assignment and mass diagnostics remain visible.
No optional persistent state is added; heavy runtime cost occurs only through worker instances when capability is used.
Parallel composition remains runtime-owned; physical process code is not made aware of external system composition.
Explicit root-active entry point; negative/NaN QROT, unsupported workers and excluded physics fail closed without silent fallback.
Admission is source-pinned, independently replayed, hard-negative tested and explicitly audited against all 30 invariants.
